CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sig_visible(_uid uuid, _created_by uuid, _assigned_to uuid, _groups text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT ((private.sig_can(_uid,'signal.view_all') OR private.sig_can(_uid,'signal.manage')
           OR private.sig_can(_uid,'signal.edit') OR private.sig_can(_uid,'signal.delete')
           OR private.sig_can(_uid,'signal.assign') OR private.sig_can(_uid,'signal.report'))
          AND private.sig_scope_ok(_uid, _groups))
    OR (_created_by = _uid AND private.sig_can(_uid,'signal.create'))
    OR (_assigned_to = _uid AND private.sig_can(_uid,'signal.sale'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sig_can(_uid uuid, _perm text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT _uid IS NOT NULL AND private.is_active(_uid)
    AND (private.is_super_admin(_uid) OR private.has_permission(_uid, _perm));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sig_scope_ok(_uid uuid, _groups text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
SELECT CASE WHEN _uid IS NULL THEN false WHEN private.is_super_admin(_uid) OR private.is_admin(_uid) THEN true
ELSE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.role_source_rows(private.base_config()) source JOIN app_roles role ON role.id=source.role_id WHERE source.user_id=_uid AND source.source_kind='slot' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(source.permissions) p WHERE p LIKE 'signal.%') AND (role.signal_scope_all OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(coalesce(_groups,'{}')) g WHERE g=ANY(role.signal_scope) OR (g LIKE 'Khác:%' AND 'Khác'=ANY(role.signal_scope))))) OR (
(NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur WHERE ur.user_id=_uid) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.org_assignments a JOIN public.base_title_role_links l ON l.title_id=a.title_id AND a.slot_id IS NULL WHERE a.user_id=_uid AND a.status='active' AND a.starts_at<=now() AND (a.ends_at IS NULL OR a.ends_at>now())))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur JOIN public.app_roles r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=_uid AND r.signal_scope_all)
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur JOIN public.app_roles r ON r.id=ur.role_id,unnest(coalesce(_groups,'{}')) g WHERE ur.user_id=_uid AND (g=ANY(r.signal_scope) OR (g LIKE 'Khác:%' AND 'Khác'=ANY(r.signal_scope))))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.org_assignments a JOIN public.base_title_role_links l ON l.title_id=a.title_id AND a.slot_id IS NULL JOIN public.app_roles r ON r.id=l.role_id WHERE a.user_id=_uid AND a.status='active' AND a.starts_at<=now() AND (a.ends_at IS NULL OR a.ends_at>now()) AND l.permission_signature=md5(coalesce(r.permissions,'{}')::text) AND r.signal_scope_all)
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.org_assignments a JOIN public.base_title_role_links l ON l.title_id=a.title_id AND a.slot_id IS NULL JOIN public.app_roles r ON r.id=l.role_id,unnest(coalesce(_groups,'{}')) g WHERE a.user_id=_uid AND a.status='active' AND a.starts_at<=now() AND (a.ends_at IS NULL OR a.ends_at>now()) AND l.permission_signature=md5(coalesce(r.permissions,'{}')::text) AND (g=ANY(r.signal_scope) OR (g LIKE 'Khác:%' AND 'Khác'=ANY(r.signal_scope))))) END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.role_source_rows(c jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, role_id text, source_kind text, source_id text, unit_id text, legacy boolean, eligible boolean, scope text, permissions text[])
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT * FROM private.slot_previous_source_rows(c)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT (m->>'user_id')::uuid,r.id,'task',m->>'id'||':'||s.id,m->>'unit_id',true,private.org_marketing_eligible((m->>'user_id')::uuid,c),'native',ARRAY(SELECT p FROM unnest(r.permissions) p WHERE private.org_role_permission_ready(p))
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(c->'memberships','[]')) m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(m->'specialty_ids','[]')) sid JOIN mkt_specialties s ON s.id=sid AND s.active JOIN app_roles r ON r.id=s.role_id
 WHERE private.is_active((m->>'user_id')::uuid) AND private.base_valid_at(m) AND m->>'status'='active' AND m->'specialty_signatures'->>s.id=md5(coalesce(r.permissions,'{}')::text) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_permission(_user_id uuid, _permission text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ SELECT private.is_active(_user_id) AND (private.is_super_admin(_user_id) OR CASE
 WHEN (private.org_role_permission_ready(_permission) OR private.mkt_specialty_permission_ready(_permission) OR _permission LIKE 'sale_work.%') AND private.base_tier1(_user_id,_permission)='DENY' THEN false
 WHEN (private.org_role_permission_ready(_permission) OR private.mkt_specialty_permission_ready(_permission) OR _permission LIKE 'sale_work.%') AND private.base_tier1(_user_id,_permission)='ALLOW' THEN true
 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_permission_overrides o WHERE o.user_id=_user_id AND o.use_custom=true AND o.mode='replace') THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_permission_overrides o WHERE o.user_id=_user_id AND o.use_custom=true AND _permission=ANY(o.permissions))
 ELSE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur JOIN app_roles r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=_user_id AND _permission=ANY(r.permissions))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_permission_overrides o WHERE o.user_id=_user_id AND o.use_custom=true AND o.mode='additive' AND _permission=ANY(o.permissions)) END) $function$
